title: fix(driver-sql): index authored single-valued master_detail, lookup and user columns
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XSpeM6gt6kAEH6dPiE8G9R)_
Fixes #31882

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：SQL 驱动给对象里作者声明的单值主从（master_detail）、查找（lookup）、用户（user）字段自动建一个普通索引 `idx_表名_列名`；多值字段、系统字段（created_by、updated_by、owner_id、owning_business_unit_id、organization_id）不建，已被声明索引作为首列覆盖的也不建。
- 为什么改：按父记录读子表（controlled_by_parent 权限过滤、相关列表）以前要扫描整个组织或全表。PostgreSQL 100 万行从 73 ms 降到 1.4 ms，SQLite 20 万行从 21 ms 降到 0.2 ms。
- 风险与回滚：批量写入变慢（一主从加一查找加一用户字段：PG 约 +12%，SQLite 约 +39%）；已有部署下次启动时补建索引，PG 上建索引期间短暂阻塞该表写入（100 万行约 0.5 s）。回滚即回退本 PR，已建的索引会在 `os migrate plan` 里显示为可删除的孤儿索引。
- 先看：`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/schema-drift.ts`（`implicitReferenceIndexesOver` 与 `declaredIndexSet`）、`sql-driver-managed-drift.ts`（启动同步）、新测试 `sql-driver-31882-reference-index-dialects.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-31882-reference-index-dialects.test.ts`，预期 SQLite 10 条全绿（配 `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` 再加 PG 2 条）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `schema-drift.ts`: `declaredIndexSet` (the one composition behind `expectedIndexes`, `diffUnbuildableIndexes`, the widened-unique pass and now `indexedKeyColumns`) appends an implicit non-unique `(column)` index for every authored single-valued `master_detail` / `lookup` / `user` field (`isImplicitlyIndexedReference`). Skipped: multi-valued (JSON) references; the platform system column names (`SystemFieldName` from `@objectstack/spec/system`: `created_by`, `updated_by`, `owner_id`, `owning_business_unit_id`, the tenant column, and so on); a column that a declared index (field-level `unique` included) already has as its leading key part; a name already in the declared set.
- Name: `buildIndexName(table, [column], false)`, which is `idx_TABLE_COLUMN`, the name an author's own `{ fields: [column] }` gets. No organization key part (seat ruling 3: the related row id is selective on its own; a declared non-unique index never gets one either, ADR-0120 D1).
- Boot sync: `syncTableIndexes` (`sql-driver-managed-drift.ts`) materializes the same implicit set through `syncDeclaredIndexes`, and the `initObjects` gate in `sql-driver-rotation.ts` opens for an object whose only indexable columns are references. Same additive path as declared indexes: plain `CREATE INDEX`, skipped by name, run at every boot.
- Because the index joins the expected set, `os migrate plan` lists a missing one as a `safe` `create_index`, and the orphan pass never proposes dropping it.
- `indexedKeyColumns` keeps its declared composition and adds the implicit reference indexes as a third pass. Same answer for every declared column; the implicit ones are added, and reference columns are `varchar(255)`, which the keyable-text decision does not touch.

Ruling: seat answer on the card, comment 6738355121 (scope B, `idx_TABLE_COLUMN`, `(column)` key, plain additive build, patch). `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` is #31901; the Mongo `master_detail` gap is #31900.

## Tests

New file `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-31882-reference-index-dialects.test.ts` (12 cases; no existing test changed):

- Expected set: a `(column)` index for each authored single-valued `master_detail` / `lookup` / `user`; none for multi-valued references or the system columns; none when a declared index leads with the column (custom name); still one when a declared index carries the column only behind another; CONTROL, the declared indexes are unchanged and in order ahead of the implicit ones.
- Boot sync (SQLite): a table without the index (an earlier release's) is planned as a `safe` `create_index`, gains the index on the next `initObjects` (exactly one `CREATE INDEX`), drift is then empty, and a further `initObjects` issues no DDL. An author who later declares `{ fields: ['project'] }` gets no DDL, the same index set, exactly one index keyed on `project`, and empty drift. No index is built on a multi-valued reference or a system column.
- Read by parent, dialect matrix (SQLite cell + live PostgreSQL cell): the organization-scoped read of one parent and the `controlled_by_parent` `$in` read both plan through `idx_os31882_time_entry_project` (`analyzeQuery`, the statement `find()` runs, organization predicate included). The PG cell turns `enable_seqscan` off on a one-connection pool, because PG picks a sequential scan on a 200-row table whatever indexes exist; the pin is that the plan CAN use the index, and without it the plan uses the tenant index instead.

## Acceptance notes

- Rotation shard tables (`ensureShardTable`) carry only the base's declared `indexes[]`, as before (they never carried field-level uniques either); implicit indexes are not added there.
- Write cost, the seat's B scope, measured at step 0 (bulkCreate 20,000 rows in 500-row batches into a table holding 20,000, median of 3): master_detail only +6% SQLite / +3% PG; master_detail + lookup + user +39% / +12%. Stated in the changeset.
- Index build on an existing table through this path: PG 16 1M rows 543 ms, SQLite 200k rows 86 ms; the PG build holds a write-blocking lock for that time (changeset says so; #31901 owns an online build).
- Recorded gap, as for the provisioned tenant index: an author has no key to opt a reference column out of the implicit index; adding one would be a spec change.
- Observation, not filed: `SqlDriver.bulkCreate` sends one statement per call, so 20,000 rows are refused on SQLite ("too many SQL variables") and PostgreSQL (bind parameter limit). Callers may already batch; not measured from a public door.
- driver-turso and driver-sqlite-wasm extend `SqlDriver` and inherit this.

## Verification

All on head `0e6a2a46` unless noted; `d02efc88` changes only the body of `indexedKeyColumns` (below).

- CI Test Core (7/8) was red at `0e6a2a46`: the CLI integration pin `packages/cli/src/commands/generate-string-family-width.pin.test.ts` reads `indexedKeyColumns`' source for `for (const idx of uniqueIndexesFromFields(table, fields, tenantField)) record(idx);`, which the refactor had removed. `d02efc88` restores that composition and adds the implicit indexes as a third loop. Reproduced locally: `Tests 1 failed | 29 passed (30)` before, `30 passed (30)` after; the five CLI files that read these sources `Tests 87 passed (87)`; driver-sql new file + `schema-drift*` `Tests 86 passed | 4 skipped (90)`; typecheck exit 0.

<details><summary>New file, SQLite + live PostgreSQL 16 (local server)</summary>

`OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=… pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/sql-driver-31882-reference-index-dialects.test.ts` · `Tests 12 passed (12)` (run at `f23301a4`, the same test and source bytes as head).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each restored, git diff HEAD empty after each)</summary>

- `isImplicitlyIndexedReference` answers false (no implicit index): 8 failed / 4 passed, including the SQLite plan pins (`expected '[{"id":2,...' to contain 'idx_os31882_time_entry_project'`) and both live PG plan pins (`expected '[{"QUERY PLAN":[{"Plan":{"Node Type":...' to contain 'idx_os31882_time_entry_project'`), the upgrade/second-sync pin and the no-duplicate pin.
- Multi-valued skip removed: 3 failed (the two skip pins and the positive set pin).
- System-column skip removed: 3 failed (same three).
- Leading-declared skip removed: 1 failed (`builds nothing for a column a declared index already leads with, whatever its name`).
</details>

<details><summary>Package suite, typecheck, lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` at `9e01edb9` (implementation, before the new file): `Test Files 247 passed | 13 skipped (260)`, `Tests 4194 passed | 224 skipped (4418)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- driver-sql has no `lint` script; root `eslint --no-inline-config` over the four changed files: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Upgrade harness (dogfood, the two files that read index drift)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/upgrade-18x-index-equivalence.dogfood.test.ts test/upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts` after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 26 passed (26)`. Full dogfood not run locally (no `!`, no narrowing arm); the queue runs it.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `0e6a2a46`: every listed command run, all exit 0 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, until studio / client-react / embedder-openai / knowledge-memory / knowledge-ragflow / scenarios were built; re-run exit 0). `--ran` reconciliation: `67 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 67 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.

Driver conformance ledger (`pnpm check:driver-conformance`): before (`a15b544d`) 66 covered, 6 DEBT, 0 exempt; after (`0e6a2a46`) 66 covered, 6 DEBT, 0 exempt. No ledger row is about this behaviour (the DEBT rows are the null-distinct unique case-set), so nothing moved; the read-by-parent pin is a driver-sql dialect-matrix suite.
</details>
